name: Taliyah
notes: Opens by casting Unraveled Earth (E) for its scatter magic damage, then casts Threaded Volley (Q) on cooldown for the rest of the fight; Taliyah never repositions, so once Worked Ground is planted under her she stands in it and every other Q cast is empowered into the Boulder.

Casts go one after another: both E and Q have a 0.25 s cast time, so a single `busy_until` in state keeps Taliyah from starting another cast or an attack until the current one's cast time has elapsed; the opening E lands at 0.00 s and keeps her busy until 0.25 s, when Q can start.

Worked Ground is only replanted by a plain Threaded Volley cast; the empowered Boulder cast consumes it without leaving new terrain (the wiki's own-terrain interaction reads this way), so casts alternate plain, empowered, plain, empowered for the whole fight.

Q's five Stone Shards are scheduled at 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.25 and 1.5 seconds after the cast: the dossier only gives the envelope (2nd/3rd shard out within 1 s, 4th/5th within a further 0.5 s), so even spacing inside each pair is assumed. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 40% damage. The barrage's shard events are damage landing from an already-started cast, not new casts, so they do not hold up other casts themselves.
Taliyah cannot basic attack until the third Stone Shard launches, so the next auto-attack is held until 1.0 s after a plain Q cast; the empowered Boulder cast has no such restriction.
The empowered Boulder is treated like a short cast at Q's own 0.25 s cast time: its damage lands on cast, and then it keeps Taliyah busy for the same 0.25 s as any other cast.

Unraveled Earth's scatter damage is treated as a single hit on the dummy (it can only be affected once per cast), landing when the 0.25 s cast starts, with `busy_until` set to 0.25 s later; the exact cascade timing of its 6 rows of stones is not modeled.

Seismic Shove (W) is never cast: it deals no damage itself, and against a stationary dummy its only value is enabling a single Unraveled Earth detonation, which is not worth the roughly 1.8 s of tempo (cast + eruption delay + knock-up travel) it would take away from casting Q; its 0.25 s cast time is kept in the kit for completeness even though the driver never spends it.
Weaver's Wall (R) is never cast: it deals no damage, only knocks aside champions and builds terrain, both irrelevant against a stationary target that ignores crowd control.
Rock Surfing (P) only grants movement speed near terrain and has no combat effect, so it is not modeled.
Monster-only bonus damage on Q and Unraveled Earth's monster damage multiplier never apply, since the dummy counts as an enemy champion.
Mana is not modeled: Q (55-75, or 10 empowered) and E (90) costs do not plausibly run Taliyah out of mana within a 15 s fight at level 16.
